scope: Primary-source requirements for a separate proven-CNS Burkitt reference pathway

verified_distinctions.source: eviQ-4492, Treatment schedule; IV folinate rescue remains separate from post-IT oral dosing.

verified_distinctions.finding: eviQ 4493 explicitly attributes days 3/7 to a committee adaptation of HOVON/SAKK, whose CNS population was excluded. It also offers a different antibody calendar. This is not randomized evidence establishing benefit in proven-CNS disease.
verified_distinctions.source: eviQ-4493, Treatment schedule footnote for rituximab

verified_distinctions.topic: Whole-course IT counts cannot be blended
verified_distinctions.finding: The distinct described calendars require explicit protocol-variant identity; the trial prose and current eviQ schedule must not be combined into one supposedly identical regimen. The trial full dosing supplement was not inspected.

verified_distinctions.topic: Burkitt evidence must not be mislabeled as the parallel DLBCL cohort
verified_distinctions.finding: The open-access Burkitt paper has Phillips as first author and McMillan as corresponding author; DOI 10.1002/jha2.3. Methods describes a parallel DLBCL cohort reported separately.

The prospective single-arm Burkitt analysis contains 27 patients, including four with CNS disease. Aggregate outcomes are not verified CNS-specific efficacy or an individual probability of cure. Trial eligibility and the broader eviQ reference population differ; advanced HIV needs specialist assessment.

required_implementation: Create separate regimen/monitoring/source identifiers for the chosen proven-CNS eviQ variant; preserve current no-proven-CNS records and their scope guards.
Encode and test IV versus IT drug separation, additional CNS IT treatments, separate IV/oral folinate clocks and the selected antibody timing; disclose consensus provenance.
Do not silently substitute the alternative trial antibody calendar or import aggregate efficacy into a CNS-specific outcome field.
Verify age/fitness, organ function, immune/HIV context and documented CNS/risk assessment before enabling automatic pathway selection; unknown values must not imply eligibility.
Add positive and negative actual-engine tests covering no-CNS, proven-CNS, low-risk, missing and conflicting context; no default or automatic alternative on failed applicability.
Verify all affected original/translated pages, cached form migrations, reader hashes, source-canonical archive copies and backend package parity before publication.
not_established: Complete age/fitness, immunodeficiency or organ-function eligibility policy
current_behavior: CNS-positive cases remain explicitly withheld from the no-proven-CNS reference; no new treatment route is introduced by this evidence review.
delivery: Current-branch audit only; production publication awaits explicit approval after prior automatic review rejection.
